bsi.editorial_reason: The identical two-word Hebrew phrase 'Eglath-shelishiyah' is present in the pinned Isaiah 15:5 and Jeremiah 48:34, both among Moabite place-names. The original lexeme may mean 'the third Eglath' as a proper locality, or 'a three-year-old heifer' in an epithet; significant scholarly editions differ. Preserve the real source phrase and both historical keys but correct the overconfident city-style editorial label so it does not assert an archaeologically proven settlement.
editorial_evidence: Alternative heifer reading documented by Bible dictionaries: https://classic.net.bible.org/dictionary.php?word=Eglath
